description: This file defines a benchmarking utility class 'benchmarker' within the 'ocudu' namespace, including functions for performance measurement, percentile calculations, and output formatting.

classes.name: ocudu::benchmarker
classes.description: A class for performing and reporting benchmarks, including timing, throughput calculations, and percentile analysis.

methods.name: do_not_optimize
methods.description: Function template to prevent compiler optimization of expressions without side-effects.

methods.name: get_max_meas_time_ns
methods.description: Returns the maximum measured execution time and associated size.

methods.name: get_percentile_width_time
methods.description: Calculates column width for percentile time output, scaled.

methods.name: get_percentile_width_throughput
methods.description: Calculates column width for throughput output, scaled.

methods.name: get_description_width
methods.description: Determines the maximum width of the description column.

methods.name: print_percentile_header
methods.description: Outputs the header for percentile performance tables.

methods.name: convert_to_throughput
methods.description: Converts measurement time and size into throughput in millions of elements/sec.

methods.name: new_measure
methods.description: Performs a benchmark measurement by executing a function repeatedly and recording durations.

methods.name: new_measure_with_context
methods.description: Performs a benchmark with setup context before timing the function.
